notes.title: Space Sucks touched down at Pixel Power Play! 🚀🧼
notes.content:
Dear Vacuum-Powered Rebels,  

We had a total blast showing off our chaotic space cleaning sim during Toronto Games Week and meeting so many amazing players in person!


Watching you playing the demo in real time was everything we hoped for. Huge thanks to everyone who stopped by, gave it a try, and shared their thoughts!

We also brought our sugar-dusted horror game Sucronomicon, and yes, cursed cookies were baked (and obliterated).

Couldn’t make it to Toronto? No worries, you can still try the Sucronomicon demo on Steam!
🩷 And don't forget to wishlist both games to stay updated and support our indie crew. 🩷



With gratitude,
The Red Meat Games and Honig Studios Teams.
